object.script:
function onTick() local axisAD = input.getNumber(1) local axisWS = input.getNumber(2) local axisLR = input.getNumber(3) local axisUD = input.getNumber(4)
local T_h_front = (-axisLR - axisAD) / 2 local T_h_rear = (-axisLR + axisAD) / 2 local T_v_front = -axisUD / 2 + axisWS / 2 local T_v_rear = -axisUD / 2 - axisWS / 2
local function vectorToPivotMotor(tx, ty) local mag = math.sqrt(tx*tx + ty*ty) if mag < 0.01 then return 0, 0 end
local motorSign = 1
if ty < 0 then tx = -tx ty = -ty motorSign = -motorSign end
if tx < 0 then tx = -tx motorSign = -motorSign end
local theta = math.atan(tx, ty) local pivot = theta / (math.pi/2) local motor = motorSign * math.min(mag, 1)
return pivot, motor end
local frontPivot, frontMotor = vectorToPivotMotor(T_h_front, T_v_front) local rearPivot, rearMotor = vectorToPivotMotor(T_h_rear, T_v_rear)
output.setNumber(1, frontPivot) output.setNumber(2, rearPivot) output.setNumber(3, frontMotor) output.setNumber(4, rearMotor) end
